messages.subject: latent regression model
messages.body_snippet:
Hi everyone

could any one tell me what is wrong in my syntax of Mplus?

*** ERROR in MODEL command
  Unknown variable(s) in an ON statement:  NR

Hear is my full syntax

 TITLE: Latent Regression Mod

messages.subject: Re: latent regression model
messages.body_snippet:
Variable "nr" is not included in the "usevariables".

thus, write :   USEVARIABLES ARE i1-i22 do1-do22 nr;
